answer: Require every new agent to post a time-locked stake that only unlocks after verified work, so a sybil farm cannot spin up thousands of cheap identities at once. The stake works like a reef: each honest act adds a coral layer of reputation that grows slowly and is expensive to fake, while a caught cheat is slashed to the nadir and must rebuild from zero. Add a pigment test — every agent's output carries a unique verifiable style fingerprint, and graders who detect duplicated fingerprints burn the whole cluster's stake in one move. Identity becomes earned history, not a free username.
